summary: First iteration: full backend + frontend test for AP GROUP KPI. 34/34 backend pytest passed (auth, RBAC, master CRUD, target/input bulk, rekap individu/divisi/perusahaan, dashboard overview, reward-punishment, setting, excel & pdf export for 4 jenis, template re-import). Frontend UI: all 3 roles login OK, dashboard renders with real data (Overall 73.96%), all admin routes reachable, RBAC redirects work for supervisor & karyawan direct URL access, Excel & PDF downloads verified, Master Divisi CRUD list rendered, Setting form fields present, User Management renders 3 seeded users.

critical.issue: Data leakage: karyawan role can see ALL employees' scores. Endpoints do not filter by user's NIK for role=karyawan. UI sidebar hides other menus but /rekap/individu still returns full 9 employees for karyawan login.

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] (CORS_ORIGINS default). Browsers reject wildcard with credentials, so httpOnly cookie flow degrades to Bearer localStorage fallback. Should set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origin(s).
response.set_cookie uses secure=True, samesite='none'; works for HTTPS preview but not on http localhost. Fine for prod, worth documenting.
Supervisor can bulk-write inputs for ANY divisi (no ownership check). Consider scoping by supervisor's divisi.

ui_bugs.issue: Empty section headers 'Master Data', 'Perencanaan', 'Admin' still render even when no items visible below them for karyawan role.

issues: Demo credentials shown in dashed panel — good for MVP but should be hidden in production.

action_items: HIGH: Enforce role-based data filtering in /api/rekap/individu, /api/reward-punishment, /api/kpi-input, /api/export/excel, /api/export/pdf so karyawan only sees own NIK. Currently client-side hiding only.
MEDIUM: Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit frontend origin (or list) instead of '*' since allow_credentials=True is used.
LOW: Hide empty sidebar section headers when no nav items are visible for user's role.
LOW: Consider restricting supervisor bulk input/target endpoints to their own divisi.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py 852 lines — approaching split threshold (>700). Consider splitting into routes/auth, routes/master, routes/kpi, routes/rekap, services/excel_import.
compute_rows is O(inputs * lookups) but master data is loaded per call; fine for current data volume.
Import overwrites entire kpi_input collection (delete_many({})) on every template import — destructive but documented behavior.
Grade thresholds compared as pct/100 (0..1 scale) against score which is total_nilai/total_bobot ratio (0..1) — internally consistent.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (auth playbook expects 5-fail lockout).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows OK; 1 data-leak issue found but UI functions)

All 3 roles seeded on startup. Frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage as primary auth (cookie is set but wildcard CORS blocks it). Main outstanding bug: karyawan role sees other employees' KPI data because backend doesn't scope by NIK.
rca of the issue: Role check happens only via require_role dependency (admin/supervisor gates). GET rekap/input/export endpoints only require get_current_user without filtering rows by user['nik']. Sidebar hides other menus for karyawan but /rekap/individu is still exposed to karyawan and returns all rows. Fix: add if user['role']=='karyawan': q['nik']=user['nik'] filter in compute_rows / rekap_individu, and reject non-individu jenis for karyawan in export endpoints.
